description: This file defines a static utility class 'ProcessorIntegrationDiscovery' that dynamically discovers, maps, and instantiates processor types implementing the 'IProcessor' interface. It employs reflection to scan assemblies, infer names, and create instances of processor classes by name.

methods.name: Discover
methods.description: Discovers and instantiates all available IProcessor implementations dynamically.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a processor given its name, using the mapped types.

methods.name: BuildProcessorMap
methods.description: Builds a dictionary mapping processor names to their respective types by scanning loaded assemblies.

methods.name: InferNames
methods.description: Generates possible names for a processor class by removing common suffixes and extracting name segments.
